rules.description: Applicant must be a non-UK national
rules.reason_if_failed: BRPs are only issued to non-UK nationals. UK nationals do not need a BRP.

rules.description: Applicant must have been granted leave to remain in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been granted a visa or leave to remain before you can collect a BRP.

rules.description: Leave to remain must be for more than 6 months
rules.reason_if_failed: BRPs are only issued for leave to remain granted for more than 6 months.

rules.description: Collection must be within 10 days of arrival in the UK
rules.reason_if_failed: You must collect your BRP within 10 days of arriving in the UK. Contact the Home Office if you've missed this deadline.

rules.description: Applicant must have a valid arrival confirmation letter
rules.reason_if_failed: You need your arrival confirmation letter which names the post office where you must collect your BRP.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is unable to collect within 10 days due to exceptional circumstances
edge_cases.action: Route to Home Office contact centre. May require evidence of exceptional circumstances (medical emergency, travel disruption).

edge_cases.description: Applicant has lost their arrival confirmation letter with post office details
edge_cases.action: Contact Home Office to request replacement collection details. Service will be handed off.

edge_cases.description: BRP is for a child under 18
edge_cases.action: Parent or legal guardian must collect on behalf of child. Additional ID verification required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has accessibility needs or requires assistance
edge_cases.action: Arrange support for post office collection. May need alternative collection arrangements.
